name: BES Engineering Corp
summary: BES Engineering Corporation is a multifaceted enterprise primarily focused on construction and engineering endeavors. Its operations are organized into distinct segments: Construction, Construction Development, and Other. The company's extensive portfolio encompasses a broad spectrum of projects, including critical civil infrastructure like roads, bridges, tunnels, ports, airports, and mass rapid transit (MRT) systems. It also specializes in the construction of specialized facilities such as high-tech manufacturing plants and hospitals, alongside developing luxury residential properties and engaging in large-scale community and industrial park development. Furthermore, BES invests in new building construction and the development of industrial districts. Beyond direct construction, BES supports the industry by leasing engineering machinery and equipment and wholesaling construction materials. The corporation also demonstrates diversified interests through its retail operations, selling food products and groceries. Its service offerings extend to apartment management, maintenance, security, movie broadcasting, theater entertainment, and the management of parking facilities. Additionally, BES provides professional consulting services in areas such as human resources, business management, and engineering. Established in 1950, BES Engineering Corporation is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
